# undangan
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#f4f5ef">
<title>Undangan Pernikahan Zainuri & Choirina</title>
<style>
:root{
  --sage:#879780; --sage-dark:#52634f; --sage-light:#e5eadf;
  --cream:#f7f7f1; --white:#fff; --ink:#29352c; --muted:#687368; --gold:#b9a778;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;line-height:1.7}
h1,h2,h3,.serif{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:400}
a{color:inherit}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.container{width:min(100% - 36px,900px);margin:auto}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--sage-dark)}
.section{padding:76px 0;text-align:center}
.section h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,6vw,3.1rem);margin:.25em 0;color:var(--sage-dark)}
.divider{width:68px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);margin:22px auto}
.cover{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#dce3d6}
.cover:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,35,25,.18),rgba(22,35,25,.62)),var(--cover-image) center 52%/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.02)}
.cover-card{position:relative;color:white;text-align:center;width:min(100%,580px);padding:52px 24px 46px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);background:rgba(28,42,30,.22);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);animation:rise 1.1s ease both}
.cover .eyebrow{color:#f3f1e7}
.cover h1{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,11vw,5.5rem);line-height:1.04;margin:18px 0;text-shadow:0 2px 18px #26332655}
.cover p{margin:8px 0}
.cover-date{letter-spacing:.14em;margin:22px 0!important}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 23px;background:var(--sage-dark);color:white;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .2s,background .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#3f503d}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;border:1px solid currentColor;color:inherit}
.cover .btn{background:#f5f5ed;color:#344532;margin-top:16px}
main{overflow:hidden}
.intro{background:var(--white)}
.couple-names{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,8vw,4rem);line-height:1.15;color:var(--sage-dark);margin:20px 0}
.quote{max-width:660px;margin:22px auto;color:var(--muted);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.1rem}
.photo-frame{max-width:560px;margin:28px auto;border:10px solid white;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #2e3c2c15}
.photo-frame img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:610px;object-fit:cover}
.details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:30px;text-align:center}
.detail-card{padding:30px 20px;background:white;border:1px solid #e2e6dd;border-radius:4px}
.detail-card h3{font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--sage-dark);margin:4px 0 12px}
.detail-card p{margin:6px 0;color:var(--muted)}
.countdown{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:30px 0}
.time-box{min-width:78px;padding:16px 12px;background:white;border:1px solid #dfe5da}
.time-box strong{display:block;font:2rem Georgia,serif;color:var(--sage-dark)}
.time-box span{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.story{max-width:650px;margin:32px auto;text-align:left;border-left:1px solid var(--gold);padding-left:25px}
.story-item{position:relative;margin:0 0 28px}
.story-item:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:9px;width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--sage);border:3px solid var(--cream);border-radius:50%}
.story-item h3{font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--sage-dark);margin:0}
.story-item p{color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,520px);justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:30px}
.gallery button{border:0;padding:0;background:none;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:3/4;max-height:560px}
.gallery img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .4s}
.gallery button:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.rsvp-wrap{max-width:600px;margin:25px auto 0;text-align:left;background:white;padding:28px;border:1px solid #e2e6dd}
label{display:block;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--sage-dark);margin:14px 0 6px}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #d5ddd1;background:#fbfcf9;border-radius:3px;font:inherit;color:var(--ink)}
textarea{min-height:95px;resize:vertical}
.rsvp-wrap .btn{width:100%;margin-top:18px}
.small-note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
.footer{background:#dfe6da;padding:44px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--sage-dark)}
.music-button{position:fixed;z-index:5;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:48px;height:48px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sage-dark);color:white;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0002}
.music-button.playing{animation:spin 5s linear infinite}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s,transform .7s}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.lightbox{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:#101610eF;z-index:20;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
.lightbox.open{display:flex}
.lightbox img{max-width:100%;max-height:85vh;object-fit:contain}
.lightbox button{position:absolute;right:18px;top:12px;background:none;color:white;border:0;font-size:2rem}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media(max-width:620px){.section{padding:58px 0}.details{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.gallery button:last-child{display:none}.cover-card{padding:42px 18px}.rsvp-wrap{padding:22px 18px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<!--
PETUNJUK CEPAT:
1) Cari bagian CONFIG di bawah dan ganti teks contoh dengan data pernikahan Anda.
2) Ganti URL foto dengan tautan foto milik Anda. Untuk file lokal, letakkan foto di folder yang sama lalu gunakan "foto-utama.jpg".
3) Ganti tanggal acara dalam format ISO, misalnya 2026-12-20T08:00:00+07:00.
4) RSVP WhatsApp baru membuka aplikasi WhatsApp dengan pesan siap kirim; data tidak otomatis tersimpan di database.
-->
<section class="cover" id="cover">
  <div class="cover-card">
    <div class="eyebrow">The Wedding Celebration</div>
    <p>Dengan penuh rasa syukur, kami mengundang</p>
    <h1 id="coverNames">Alya &amp; Raka</h1>
    <p>untuk hadir dan menjadi bagian dari hari bahagia kami</p>
    <p class="cover-date" id="coverDate">MINGGU, 20 DESEMBER 2026</p>
    <p>Kepada Yth.</p>
    <p><strong id="guestName">Tamu Undangan</strong></p>
    <button class="btn" id="openInvitation">Buka Undangan <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
  </div>
</section>
<main id="mainContent" hidden>
  <section class="section intro">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh</div>
      <p class="quote">“Dan di antara tanda-tanda kekuasaan-Nya ialah Dia menciptakan untukmu pasangan hidup dari jenismu sendiri, supaya kamu merasa tenteram kepadanya.”</p>
      <p class="small-note">QS. Ar-Rum: 21 (kutipan makna)</p>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <p>Dengan memohon rahmat dan ridha Allah SWT, kami bermaksud menyelenggarakan pernikahan putra-putri kami:</p>
      <h2 class="couple-names"><span id="brideName">Alya Putri</span><br><small style="font-size:.5em;color:var(--gold)">&amp;</small><br><span id="groomName">Raka Pratama</span></h2>
      <p id="parentsText">Putri dari Bapak … &amp; Ibu … <br>Putra dari Bapak … &amp; Ibu …</p>
      <div class="photo-frame"><img id="mainPhoto" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1519741497674-611481863552?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85" alt="Foto pasangan pengantin"></div>
      <p class="quote">“Dua hati, satu tujuan, dan sebuah perjalanan baru yang dimulai bersama.”</p>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Save the Date</div><h2>Menuju Hari Bahagia</h2><div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="countdown" aria-label="Hitung mundur">
        <div class="time-box"><strong id="days">00</strong><span>Hari</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><strong id="hours">00</strong><span>Jam</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><strong id="minutes">00</strong><span>Menit</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><strong id="seconds">00</strong><span>Detik</span></div>
      </div>
      <p id="dateReadable">Minggu, 20 Desember 2026</p>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section" style="background:#edf0e8">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">With Love</div><h2>Rangkaian Acara</h2><div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="details">
        <article class="detail-card"><div class="eyebrow">Acara Pertama</div><h3>Akad Nikah</h3><p id="akadDate">Minggu, 20 Desember 2026</p><p id="akadTime">08.00 WIB – selesai</p><p id="akadPlace">Rumah Mempelai Pria</p><p id="akadAddress">Alamat lengkap lokasi acara</p><a class="btn" id="akadMaps" href="https://maps.google.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Lihat Lokasi</a></article>
        <article class="detail-card"><div class="eyebrow">Acara Kedua</div><h3>Resepsi</h3><p id="receptionDate">Minggu, 20 Desember 2026</p><p id="receptionTime">11.00–14.00 WIB</p><p id="receptionPlace">Rumah Mempelai Pria</p><p id="receptionAddress">Alamat lengkap lokasi acara</p><a class="btn" id="receptionMaps" href="https://maps.google.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Lihat Lokasi</a></article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Our Journey</div><h2>Kisah Kami</h2><div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="story">
        <div class="story-item"><h3>Awal Pertemuan</h3><p>Setiap kisah indah selalu punya awal. Di sinilah perjalanan kami dimulai—silakan ganti dengan cerita pertemuan kalian.</p></div>
        <div class="story-item"><h3>Menjalin Cerita</h3><p>Hari demi hari, kami belajar saling mengenal, mendukung, dan bertumbuh bersama.</p></div>
        <div class="story-item"><h3>Hari Lamaran</h3><p>Dengan restu keluarga, kami mantap melangkah menuju babak baru kehidupan.</p></div>
        <div class="story-item"><h3>Hari Pernikahan</h3><p>Dengan penuh syukur, kami mengawali perjalanan baru sebagai pasangan.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section" style="background:#edf0e8">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Captured Moments</div><h2>Galeri Kami</h2><div class="divider"></div>
      <p>Beberapa momen yang ingin kami kenang selamanya.</p>
      <div class="gallery" id="gallery">
        <button type="button" aria-label="Perbesar foto 1"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1537633552985-df8429e8048b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80" alt="Momen pasangan 1"></button>
        
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section">
    <div class="container reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Kindly Respond</div><h2>Konfirmasi Kehadiran</h2><div class="divider"></div>
      <p>Kehadiran dan doa restu Anda merupakan kebahagiaan bagi kami.</p>
      <form class="rsvp-wrap" id="rsvpForm">
        <label for="rsvpName">Nama</label><input id="rsvpName" name="name" required placeholder="Nama Anda">
        <label for="attendance">Konfirmasi kehadiran</label><select id="attendance" name="attendance"><option value="Hadir">Insyaallah hadir</option><option value="Tidak dapat hadir">Mohon maaf, tidak dapat hadir</option></select>
        <label for="guestCount">Jumlah tamu</label><select id="guestCount" name="count"><option>1 orang</option><option>2 orang</option><option>3 orang</option><option>4 orang</option></select>
        <label for="message">Ucapan dan doa (opsional)</label><textarea id="message" name="message" placeholder="Tuliskan ucapan terbaik Anda..."></textarea>
        <button class="btn" type="submit">Kirim melalui WhatsApp</button>
        <p class="small-note">Pesan akan dibuka di WhatsApp untuk Anda periksa dan kirim. Data belum tersimpan otomatis di website.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="footer"><div class="eyebrow">Thank You</div><h2 class="serif">Merupakan kehormatan bagi kami</h2><p>atas doa dan kehadiran Anda.</p><p class="serif" id="footerNames" style="font-size:2rem">Alya &amp; Raka</p><p class="small-note">Dibuat dengan penuh cinta ♡</p></section>
</main>
<button class="music-button" id="musicButton" aria-label="Putar musik" title="Putar / jeda musik">♫</button>
<audio id="bgMusic" loop preload="none"></audio>
<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox" role="dialog" aria-label="Foto diperbesar"><button id="closeLightbox" aria-label="Tutup">&times;</button><img id="lightboxImage" alt="Foto galeri diperbesar"></div>
<script>
// ======================= CONFIG: EDIT DATA DI SINI =======================
const CONFIG = {
  bride: "Choirina",
  groom: "Zainuri",
  brideShort: "Choirina",
  groomShort: "Zainuri",
  brideParents: "Chamdan & Mahbubanaliya",
  groomParents: "Thahir & Kasti",
  guestName: "Tamu Undangan",
  // Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+07:00
  eventDate: "2026-11-08T08:00:00+07:00",
  dateLabel: "Minggu, 8 November 2026",
  akadTime: "08.00 WIB – selesai",
  receptionTime: "Siang – malam",
  venue: "Rumah Mempelai Pria",
  address: "Dsn. Talok, RT 04 RW 02, Kec. Kalitidu, Kab. Bojonegoro",
  mapsUrl: "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dusun+Talok+RT+04+RW+02+Kalitidu+Bojonegoro",
  whatsappNumber: "", // format internasional, tanpa + atau spasi
  heroPhoto: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  galleryPhotos: ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"],
  musicUrl: "" // Tambahkan URL audio yang Anda miliki/berizin; belum diisi
};
// ===================== END CONFIG =====================

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const fullNames = `${CONFIG.brideShort} & ${CONFIG.groomShort}`;
$("coverNames").textContent = fullNames;
$("footerNames").textContent = fullNames;
$("brideName").textContent = CONFIG.bride;
$("groomName").textContent = CONFIG.groom;
$("guestName").textContent = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("to") || CONFIG.guestName;
$("parentsText").innerHTML = `Putri dari ${CONFIG.brideParents}<br>Putra dari ${CONFIG.groomParents}`;
$("coverDate").textContent = CONFIG.dateLabel.toLocaleUpperCase("id-ID");
$("dateReadable").textContent = CONFIG.dateLabel;
$("akadDate").textContent = CONFIG.dateLabel;
$("receptionDate").textContent = CONFIG.dateLabel;
$("akadTime").textContent = CONFIG.akadTime;
$("receptionTime").textContent = CONFIG.receptionTime;
$("akadPlace").textContent = CONFIG.venue;
$("receptionPlace").textContent = CONFIG.venue;
$("akadAddress").textContent = CONFIG.address;
$("receptionAddress").textContent = CONFIG.address;
$("akadMaps").href = CONFIG.mapsUrl;
$("receptionMaps").href = CONFIG.mapsUrl;
$("mainPhoto").src = CONFIG.heroPhoto;
document.querySelector(".cover").style.setProperty("--cover-image", `url("${CONFIG.heroPhoto}")`);
const galleryImages = $("gallery").querySelectorAll("img");
CONFIG.galleryPhotos.forEach((src,i)=>{if(galleryImages[i]) galleryImages[i].src=src;});
$("bgMusic").src = CONFIG.musicUrl;
const eventTime = new Date(CONFIG.eventDate).getTime();
function updateCountdown(){
  let diff = Math.max(0, eventTime - Date.now());
  $("days").textContent = String(Math.floor(diff/86400000)).padStart(2,"0");
  $("hours").textContent = String(Math.floor(diff%86400000/3600000)).padStart(2,"0");
  $("minutes").textContent = String(Math.floor(diff%3600000/60000)).padStart(2,"0");
  $("seconds").textContent = String(Math.floor(diff%60000/1000)).padStart(2,"0");
}
updateCountdown(); setInterval(updateCountdown,1000);
$("openInvitation").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  $("mainContent").hidden=false;
  $("mainContent").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
  if(CONFIG.musicUrl) $("bgMusic").play().then(()=>{$("musicButton").classList.add("playing")}).catch(()=>{});
});
$("musicButton").addEventListener("click",async()=>{
  if(!CONFIG.musicUrl){alert("Tambahkan URL file musik pada CONFIG.musicUrl terlebih dahulu.");return;}
  try{if($("bgMusic").paused){await $("bgMusic").play();$("musicButton").classList.add("playing");}else{$("bgMusic").pause();$("musicButton").classList.remove("playing");}}catch(e){alert("Musik tidak dapat diputar. Periksa URL file audio.");}
});
$("rsvpForm").addEventListener("submit",e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const name=$("rsvpName").value.trim();
  const attendance=$("attendance").value;
  const count=$("guestCount").value;
  const message=$("message").value.trim();
  const text=`Assalamu'alaikum, saya ${name}.%0AKonfirmasi: ${attendance}.%0AJumlah tamu: ${count}.%0AUcapan/doa: ${message || "-"}`;
  const number=CONFIG.whatsappNumber.replace(/\D/g,"");
  if(!number || number==="6281234567890"){alert("Silakan ganti CONFIG.whatsappNumber dengan nomor WhatsApp penerima RSVP yang benar.");return;}
  window.open(`https://wa.me/${number}?text=${text}`,"_blank","noopener");
});
const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add("visible");observer.unobserve(entry.target);}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
$("gallery").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
  $("lightboxImage").src=btn.querySelector("img").src;$("lightbox").classList.add("open");
}));
function closeLightbox(){$("lightbox").classList.remove("open");}
$("closeLightbox").addEventListener("click",closeLightbox);
$("lightbox").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===$("lightbox"))closeLightbox();});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")closeLightbox();});
</script>
</body>
</html>
